title:
Epic that applies select all functionality with derived properties to a data grid.

When triggered, this epic either clears all selected items or sets all items
from a derived property source, depending on the current selection state.

**Functionality:**
- If grid has selected items: clears all selections
- If grid has no selected items: sets all items from derived property source

@see UiSdlDataGrid
name: ApplySelectAllWithDerivedPropsGridEpic
